The Cave main-menu audio notice
================================

The file sounds/the-cave-main-menu-stone-mining.ogg is an original edit,
arrangement and mix made for The Cave from the following CC0 recordings:

1. "Garden pickaxe hitting rock"
   Creator: Sadiquecat
   Source: https://freesound.org/people/Sadiquecat/sounds/855629/
   License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0)

2. "Pickaxe1"
   Creator: NoisyRedFox
   Source: https://freesound.org/people/NoisyRedFox/sounds/760565/
   License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0)

3. "Pick axe striking rocks #1.m4a"
   Creator: guyburns
   Source: https://freesound.org/people/guyburns/sounds/558414/
   License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0)

The source recordings were trimmed, filtered, layered, arranged and mixed into
the 80-second Stonebreaker menu loop. No attribution is required by CC0; this
notice is included to preserve source provenance.
